name: start_task
title: Start work on a task
description: Start a task on your own authority (an owner request only under owner_request) or on a signal_id; also restarts a stalled card in its work stage. Gates, prerequisites and the PM stage-move rules apply. A refused start waits for nothing; the error names why (e.g. member_at_capacity, assignee_unfit).

assignee.description: Name one only when you must: the system's choice keeps the member's complexity limit, and with team.assigneeFit an assignee beyond the limit or specialty is refused (assignee_unfit). Score a hard card first, or ask the scorer.

despite_prerequisites.description: Honored only when the project settings let the PM override prerequisites.

signal_id.description: An overdue-obligation signal on a card, when the project lets you act on signals: starts the card's own assignee, without an owner request; no assignee or despite_prerequisites then.
